kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the printed lower portion — 4 patterns (the TCA-for-neuropathic-pain off-label stem with the failed-approved-options reason, the three-continent replication consistency stem, the 2x/5x/12x dose-response vs animal-data gradient/experiment stem, and the RR-9 post-infusion pancreatitis temporality-is-required stem), 4 traps (strength vs temporality, plausibility vs coherence, consistency vs strength, off-label vs contraindicated/experimental), 3 pivots (exposure-quantified vs replicated, gradient vs specificity, measure-question vs judgment-question), a 10-card recall set covering both printed blocks, and the solvent-neuropathy miniCase with 4 options (exactly 1 correct) whose distractors each cite a DIFFERENT printed criterion and the proves-causation trap.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the nine definitions and the off-label paragraph only; every vignette, distractor design, and reverse-direction question shape is KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The MEASURE/THINK/GATE decoder and the four-move causal-inference protocol: MOVE 1 check the gate (temporality — the cause must precede the effect by an expected amount of time; wrong order fails the claim), MOVE 2 count the measured evidence (strength, consistency, biological gradient, experiment — evidence you COUNT), MOVE 3 weigh the thinking evidence (specificity, plausibility, coherence, analogy — evidence you REASON), MOVE 4 render the verdict (limited support — necessary but not sufficient — supports causation, never proves it). Includes the sentence-to-criterion question translations (HOW BIG / DOES IT REPLICATE / DOSE-RESPONSE / CAN IT BE SHOWN / ONE CAUSE ONE EFFECT / MECHANISM / CONFLICT / SEEN BEFORE).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints nine flat definitions with no grouping, no protocol, and no claim that temporality is the required criterion; the courtroom organization and the required-gate gloss are KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[0] causal-verdict-map + blocks[3] the list block + blocks[4] the steps block + the registry visual's legend and card tags

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (SOME CATS SLEEP TIGHT; BIG PURRING CATS EAT ANTS — the nine in printed order; TIME IS THE GATE; MEASURE IT OR THINK IT; NONE APPROVED, OR THE APPROVED ONES FAILED — the off-label reasons). No mnemonic prints anywhere in the lower portion of pdf 279 (VLM-confirmed), so all four ALL-CAPS codes are KYP originals; the upper portion's 'Can I SWIM?' belongs to clinical-therapeutic-trials and is NOT carried here.

kypExtensions.summary: The association-vs-causation compare block — what studies MEASURE (the 2x2 output: OR/RR/AR) vs what the criteria SUPPORT (limited evidence of a causal relationship) — built on the Strength row's printed caveat ('Association does not necessarily imply causation') and the lead-in's 'limited support', with the bias/confounding bridge (what manufactures association without causation) and the strength link (a strong association is more evidence FOR causation, never proof).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the caveat inside one criterion row but never builds the two-column contrast; the compare structure and the exam question-shape rows are KYP's.

kypExtensions.summary: The KYP-context generalizations, every one flagged as such: temporality as the only criterion that MUST hold (the gate gloss), the smoking-lung cancer / asbestos-mesothelioma worked causal cases, latency as temporality's clinical shadow, pediatrics and rare disease as off-label territory, off-label prescribing as legal judgment beyond the label (informed-awareness and Phase 4 surveillance links), and the TCA pharmacology behind the printed example (amitriptyline/nortriptyline — monoamine reuptake inhibition plus sodium-channel blockade for neuropathic pain at sub-antidepressant doses).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source is one printed half-page of definitions; every mechanism, indication, latency, legality, and worked-example statement beyond the printed text is KYP context, explicitly marked in the note and never presented as printed text.
